items.title: Retiring MP High Court Justice Avanindra Kumar Singh to donate ₹1.01 crore GPF savings to PM CARES Fund
items.summary: Retiring Madhya Pradesh High Court Justice Avanindra Kumar Singh pledged to donate his entire General Provident Fund (GPF) savings, estimated at ₹1.01 crore, to the Prime Minister's Citizen Assistance and Relief in Emergency Situations (PM CARES) Fund after his retirement. At his farewell function on September 17, Justice Singh also revealed that he and his wife Shivati Indra Singh have pledged to donate their bodies to a medical college after their deaths for scientific purposes. The announcement came as Justice Singh reflected on his 37 years of service, the people who shaped his career and the principles he carried with him as a judge. Reflecting on his retirement, Justice Singh conveyed he intended to continue working in a different capacity. “After retirement today, I will begin a new chapter in my life, and I will always continue to work on a new platform. I believe that we serve the Lord not only by worshipping Him, but also by taking care of all things big and small God has created on this earth,” said Justice Singh.
